Thanks again for walking us through the MAP yesterday. We reviewed the updated timeline and have two constraints from procurement that will affect signature timing:

- HexaGrid needs an internal finance approval window between Mar 8–12 (they'll only countersign after that).
- Our commercial team prefers start dates on Mondays to align with onboarding cohorts (preferred: Mar 22 or Mar 29).

We'd like to lock the doc this week so procurement can circulate to finance.

Thanks,

  3) General Counsel (depending on any final redlines)

Neha / Karthik — from an onboarding perspective:

- We can support a Mar 22 start but it will require the kickoff to be fully executed and signatures in place no later than Mar 12 so we can finalize the onboarding roster and prework.
- If countersign slips past Mar 12 but before Mar 19, we can still make Mar 29 work as a start date.
- Resource note: we'll allocate one Senior Onboard Engineer and one Solutions Architect for the first two weeks for HG onboarding. If they want accelerated ramp (additional parallel sessions), there will be an add-on cost (can outline if they push for Mar 22 but sign late).

I'll attach the kickoff draft and a proposed agenda for a Mar 22 start (Kickoff_agenda_draft.docx).

Maya — great, thanks for the constraints. Confirming Redwood's position and the routing plan:

1) Price hold: we will hold the quoted pricing and ramp schedule provided the contract is countersigned by Mar 12, 2027. If countersign occurs after Mar 12, pricing will need a short repricing review (but we will keep the original commercial intent and work with you on a minimal delta).

2) DocuSign routing: we will initiate routing on Mar 9 with the following signer order: Neha (Sales) -> Head of Revenue Ops (internal ops confirmation) -> HexaGrid countersign (Procurement). Legal (Karthik) will be on the recipient list for visibility and to jump in if any unexpected redlines appear. This timeline is designed to meet a Mar 12 countersign target.

3) Start date options:
   - If countersign by Mar 12: confirmed start Mar 22.
   - If countersign between Mar 13–Mar 19: we shift to Mar 29.

4) Onboarding resources: Camila confirms Senior Onboard Eng + Solutions Architect reserved for week-of-start. If HexaGrid requires accelerated parallel deliveries to keep the Mar 22 start with late sign, we'll provide a one-time acceleration estimate.

5) Next steps for procurement: please confirm earliest date procurement will submit the final redline. Once we have the green light, we'll send the DocuSign packet (link below) and a short readout of the kickoff agenda.

DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/HG-4572-sign
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HG-4572

If that works, I'll send the packet on Mar 9 and loop GC if legal redlines show up.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
